login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to your Olivin account to manage your profile and orders.

loginCode.title: Sign in with a code
loginCode.description: Enter your email address and we'll send a one-time sign-in code.
loginCode.requestFailed: Could not send sign-in code. Please try again.
loginCode.confirmDescription: We sent a one-time code to the provided email address. Enter it below.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: Create an Olivin customer account. We will send a confirmation code to the provided email address.
register.usernameHint: 3–30 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash, or underscore.
register.consentTerms: I accept the terms and conditions.
register.consentMarketing: I would like to receive marketing information by email (optional).

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.description: We sent a confirmation code to the address provided during registration. Enter it below.
verifyEmail.success: Email confirmed. Your account is ready.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app or a recovery code to complete sign-in.
mfa.success: Code accepted. You are signed in.

passwordReset.title: Reset your password
passwordReset.description: Enter your account's email address. We'll send a code to set a new password.
passwordReset.requestFailed: Could not send the reset code. Please try again.
passwordReset.confirmDescription: Enter the code from the email and your new password.

errors.emailTaken: An account with this email address already exists.
errors.usernameInvalid: Username may contain letters, numbers, dot, dash, and underscore (3–30 characters).
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.passwordInvalid: Password does not meet security requirements.
errors.consentRequired: Accept the terms and conditions and privacy policy.
errors.codeRequired: Enter the code from the email.
errors.codeInvalid: The code is invalid or has expired.
errors.codeExpired: The code has expired or the attempt limit was reached. Request a new code.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
errors.registrationFailed: Could not create account. Please try again.
errors.verificationFailed: Could not confirm email. Please try again.
errors.mfaFailed: Could not confirm code. Please try again.
errors.mfaExpired: Sign-in expired. Please sign in again.
